stem:
Meera is making a torch circuit for her school science project in Jaipur. The figure shows the actual circuit she has connected on her table: one cell, a closed switch and one bulb, joined in a single loop with wires.

Which circuit diagram correctly represents Meera's circuit?

options.text: A cell and a bulb in series, with no switch shown.
A cell, a closed switch and a bulb, all in series in one loop.
A cell with the switch and the bulb connected in parallel branches.
Two cells and a bulb in series, with the switch left open.

teacher.key_rationale: The physical circuit in the figure has exactly three components in one continuous loop: one cell, a closed switch and one bulb. Only option B shows all three components in series in a single loop; A omits the switch, C puts components in parallel and D adds a second cell and shows an open switch, so none of these match the actual circuit.
teacher.figure_note: Figure added as required: circuitikz-style tikzpicture of the actual circuit (cell, closed switch, bulb in series) that the stem refers to.
